lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我喜欢看书，听音乐，还喜欢爬山。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan kàn shū, tīng yīnyuè, hái xǐhuan páshān.
lines.english: I like reading, listening to music, and also mountain climbing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 一个月一次吧。周末和朋友一起去。
lines.pinyin: Yī gè yuè yī cì ba. Zhōumò hé péngyou yīqǐ qù.
lines.english: Once a month. Weekends go with friends.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 小说、历史书、科普书都看。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎoshuō, lìshǐ shū, kēpǔ shū dōu kàn.
lines.english: Novels, history books, popular science books, all read.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What type of music do you like?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 轻音乐、民谣。让人安静、放心。
lines.pinyin: Qīng yīnyuè, mínyáo. Ràng rén ānjìng, fàngxīn.
lines.english: Light music, folk. Makes people quiet, at ease.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 爱好真多！生活一定很丰富。
lines.pinyin: Àihào zhēn duō! Shēnghuó yídìng hěn fēngfù.
lines.english: So many hobbies! Life must be very rich.
